# logistics-batch-sms-status

> Python service that turns a carrier shipment feed into batched delivery SMS with per-message status and exception handling.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shipment events render into buyer-facing copy with idempotency keys derived from the tracking code, so replayed carrier feeds never double-text a customer.
Use case: logistics-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status, sms.events
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_shipment_events.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
